# DeepSeek Harness Plugins

Plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
Each one gives the agent a provider's tools and draws what it finds as

cards and
panels in the Web Client instead of raw JSON: Jira and Confluence, Sentry, GitLab,
Figma,
and a real browser for checking UI work.

A plugin connects however its provider allows — a browser OAuth flow, a personal
token the user past

es, or no credential at all for a server on the same machine.
Built against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; every

al at all for a server on the same machine.
Built against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; every package is on npm.
## Install
Install all plugins at once — Plugins → Add plugin → `dsh-workflow-plugin`.

Add the market index as a source — the sidebar Plugins page, then Discover, with
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-e
xperimental-plugin-market-bundle` turned on:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`dsh-workflow-plugin` is the shortcut: it depends on seven bundles and
mounts a row for each, so one

install gives you all of them. Install it
**instead of** the individual bundles, not beside them —

two profile layers
inserting a row with the same id is a duplicate the loader refuses.
Or install one bundle straight from npm:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

An individual bundle carries its own settings card. When the suite's Integrations
page is not instal

led, the card appears as its own Settings section instead; add
`dsh-integrations-plugin` to group ev
ery connection on one page.

Discover keeps the index it read, and the entry it holds names one exact version,
so after a new rel

ease reload the page — otherwise it keeps offering the version it
fetched.

> [!WARNING]
> All plugins are in **active development**. Each version may contain **breaking change
s**, be **unstable**, or have **security vulnerabilities**. Use them **at your own risk**.
## Packages
| Package | What it is |

| `dsh-atlassian-plugin` | Jira and Confluence, over Atlassian's remote MCP server |
| `dsh-sentry-p

lugin` | Sentry errors, with an issue panel |
| `dsh-gitlab-plugin` | Merge requests, review threads

and pipelines, over REST |
| `dsh-figma-plugin` | A frame, its variables and its Code Connect mappi

ng, from the local Dev Mode server |
| `dsh-browser-plugin` | A real browser the agent drives to che

ck its UI work, one browser per session, live in the side panel |
| `dsh-integrations-plugin` | The

one Settings page the connection cards appear on |
| `dsh-devkit-plugin` | The project's own lint, t

ypecheck, test and build recipes |
| `dsh-workflow-plugin` | Every bundle above behind one profile e

ntry |
| `dsh-mcp-oauth` | OAuth for MCP servers, and the authenticated bridge |
| `dsh-integration-

host` | Host-half shell: endpoint patch, sign-in state, settings route, slash command |
| `dsh-integ

ration-ui` | Browser-half shell: panel body, result card, tool row, settings card, stylesheet |
| `d
sh-plugin-build` | The build every plugin runs |

The last four are libraries: a plugin bundles them from source, so nothing
installs them at runtime.
## Plugins

**Atlassian.** The tools of `https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp` become ordinary
harness tools (`mcp__

atlassian__searchJiraIssuesUsingJql`, `getJiraIssue`,
`searchConfluenceUsingCql`, …) with the normal

permission and approval pipeline.
`atlassian_present` shows an issue, a shortlist or Confluence pag
signee can be changed. `/atlassian status|login|logout|sync`.

**Sentry.** `mcp.sentry.dev/mcp` over the same OAuth library. `sentry_present`
shows a search or a l

ist of issue ids with status, assignee and event counts;
clicking one opens the whole issue — stack

trace, code location, suspect commit,
tags — with **Resolve**, **Ignore**, **Reopen** and **Assign**

. `/sentry
status|login|logout|sync`.

**GitLab.** The REST API with a personal access token, not MCP: GitLab's MCP
endpoint is off unless

an Owner of the top-level group turns it on, and its tokens
carry the single scope `mcp`, which no R

EST call accepts. The agent reads GitLab
with `gitlab_list_merge_requests`, `gitlab_get_merge_reques

t` (description, diff,
review discussions, newest pipeline), `gitlab_get_job_log` and `gitlab_read`

for
any other GET — issues, commits, branches, search — instead of reaching for `glab`
and hunting f

or a token in the shell. `gitlab_present` shows merge requests,
review findings and failed jobs as a

card; the panel has Overview, Diff,
Discussions and Pipeline sections. `gitlab_review` comments, re

plies, resolves and
approves — every one of those changes somebody else's merge request, so it answe

rs
with the exact text it would post until the call carries `confirm`, and the panel
shows the same
draft with a Send button. `/gitlab status|login|logout|sync`.

**Figma.** The Dev Mode MCP server the desktop app serves on
`http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp` — no sign-i

n and no token, so the settings card
reports the connection instead of asking for one. `figma_presen

t` answers the
model with a node's structure, variables and Code Connect mapping **as text**, and
sh

ows the person the frame itself: a screenshot costs far more context than the
[该节后续省略]

en. `debug` logs the raw payload of every

## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

From the root, `bun run market` rewrites `docs/market.json` and `bun run market
--check` fails when

the committed index no longer describes the packages. Publish
times are not compared: they move the

moment a version is released, which is the
same moment the file is committed, so they would redden e

very push. Releases
go through changesets:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The libraries are published too: a published plugin's `devDependencies` name them
by version, and th
e versions a release records have to exist.

How to work in this repository — AGENTS.md. What is planned, and why,
and what was measured on the w
ay — docs/roadmap.md.
